description: Had cut the loaf on the line, and did not ask for the book.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured the loaf, moved the cat, and kept the rent from becoming a second claim.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Moved off the chronicle. Not in the talk except as a sitter.
name: Gib

description: Not in the house. His book was kept for the shelf.
name: Richard Field

description: Spoke from the window and stayed.
name: William Shakespeare
